fr.sorbonne_u.components.hem2026e1.equipments.batteries

Interface BatteriesCI

  • All Superinterfaces:
    BatteriesConfigurationI, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.ComponentInterface, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.OfferedCI, java.rmi.Remote, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.RequiredCI
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    BatteriesConnector, BatteriesInboundPort, BatteriesOutboundPort

    public interface BatteriesCI
extends fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.RequiredCI, fr.sorbonne_u.components.interfaces.OfferedCI, BatteriesConfigurationI
    The component interface BatteriesCI defines the signatures of the services that are offered by batteries components.

    Description

    This component interface proposes as services the same signatures as in the implementation interface BatteriesImplementationI.

    Invariants

     invariant       !(areCharging() && areDischarging())

    Created on : 2025-09-25

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant
